name: South Tampa Bicycle Co
metaTitle: South Tampa Bicycle Co: Bikes in Tampa
metaDescription: South Tampa Bicycle Co at 3431 S Westshore Blvd sells inspected pre-owned bikes and custom builds. Weekdays run 10am to 6pm, and Sunday is closed to ride.

publish.hoursNote: Hours from southtampabicycleco.com. Sunday is marked closed to ride.

facts: South Tampa Bicycle Co, bicycle shop, Tampa. Address 3431 S. Westshore Blvd, Tampa, FL 33629. Phone (813) 319-3735. Email SouthTampaBicycleCo@gmail.com. Website https://southtampabicycleco.com/.

The site says it is a small locally owned shop specializing in pre-owned bikes and custom builds, that inventory changes, that bikes are professionally inspected and serviced, and that nationwide shipping is available. It also invites people to sell a bike.

Hours Monday through Friday 10am to 6pm, Saturday 10am to 3pm, Sunday closed to ride. Example prices on the page include a 2015 Pinarello at $3,250.00, a 2022 Pinarello at $3,395.00, and a Fuji ACE kids road bike at $400.00.
Stored database hours match the weekday and Saturday clocks and mark Sunday closed.

Nearby from our coordinates: Gogos Greek Grill 0.15 miles at 3343 S Westshore Blvd, slug gogos-greek-grill. Life Essentials Refillery 0.61 miles at 4317 W El Prado Blvd, slug life-essentials-refillery. Spotless Car Wash South 0.61 miles at 4325 W Euclid Ave, slug spotless-car-wash.

faq.q: Is South Tampa Bicycle Co open on Sunday?
faq.a: The site says Sunday is closed to ride. Weekdays are 10am to 6pm and Saturday is 10am to 3pm.
The homepage says nationwide shipping is available. Ask (813) 319-3735 which bike can ship before you pay.

faq.q: Can I sell them a bike?
faq.a: The site has a sell-your-bike path. The page does not print a payout formula, so ask by email at SouthTampaBicycleCo@gmail.com.
